question:
**Identify the correct spelling of the underlined word.**

It is considered a great __phenamina__ in the field of economics.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Phenomenon". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Phenomenon" **is a singular noun that refers to an observable event or a fact that can be scientifically described or explained.
 
• The correct spelling follows the phonetic and etymological rules of English, derived from Greek, where **"ph" **is used instead of **"f," **and the proper arrangement of vowels follows the **"e-o" **pattern after the consonant **"n."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Phinomina: This option is incorrectly spelled and does not represent any recognized English word.
 
• Fenomena: This option attempts to mimic the correct pronunciation but fails to adhere to the standard English spelling conventions.
 
• Phynamena: This option also does not match the correct spelling, demonstrating a misunderstanding of the word's phonetic structure.
